subject: Re: Kickoff: ColTran archive colorization
body:
Hi Lucia,

Staffing: Hyun Traore leads at 60%, Maren Zhou 40% on the fine-tuning pipeline and datasets, Efe Lindqvist 30% on eval and the FID harness.

Compute: titan-a100 best-effort, 48 GPUs for fine-tuning runs — the three stages train separately so we can pipeline them through a modest allocation.

On serving cost: we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch to compress the autoregressive colorizer into a feed-forward student for cheap serving — Hyun owns the recipe design inside his 60%, Maren supports on training infra. There's nothing on the shelf internally we can reuse for this, so I've budgeted it as a fresh build with a first student checkpoint targeted mid-June.

Flag: archive-customer data likely needs privacy review before fine-tuning; filing this week given the 2-3 week SLA.

Santiago
